name: io.github.KelvinCampelo/clickup-full-mcp
title: ClickUp (full API)
description: Complete ClickUp API (173 v2+v3 operations) in 4 tools, ~700 tokens. Tasks, time, Chat, Docs.

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ClickUp personal API token (pk_...) or OAuth access token

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Workspace (team) ID, auto-filled into team_id / workspace_id

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_TOOL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: meta (default: 4 tools for the whole API) or full (one tool per endpoint)

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose, e.g. tasks,comments,time_tracking

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true to expose only read (GET) operations

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_RESPONSE_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: compact (default: minified, null/empty fields removed), json (every field) or pretty (indented)
